meta.title: SmileCare Dental Clinic — Modern Dentistry in Paris
meta.description: Modern, gentle dentistry for the whole family. General dentistry, orthodontics, whitening, implants, pediatric dentistry and emergency care.

hero.subtitle: Modern, gentle and patient-centred dentistry in the heart of Paris. Advanced technology, transparent pricing and a team that truly cares about your comfort.

results.title: Before / After
results.subtitle: See the real transformations our patients have achieved with our treatments.

services.title: Complete Dental Care
services.subtitle: From routine check-ups to full smile makeovers — every treatment is personalised and performed with the latest technology.

items.name: General Dentistry
items.description: Check-ups, cleanings, fillings and preventive care to keep your smile healthy all year round.

items.name: Orthodontics
items.description: Traditional braces and clear aligners to straighten teeth for both adults and teenagers.

items.name: Teeth Whitening
items.description: Safe, professional whitening that brightens your smile by several shades in a single visit.

items.name: Dental Implants
items.description: Permanent, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth, restored with titanium implants.

items.name: Pediatric Dentistry
items.description: Gentle, fun dental care designed to make children feel safe and build healthy habits early.

items.name: Emergency Care
items.description: Same-day appointments for pain, broken teeth and dental accidents — whenever you need us.

about.title: A Team Devoted to Your Smile
about.paragraph1: SmileCare Dental Clinic was founded with one mission: to make quality dentistry accessible, comfortable and worry-free. Our modern clinic combines medical excellence with a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
about.paragraph2: Every treatment starts with a conversation. We listen, explain and involve you in every decision, so you always know exactly what to expect — no surprises, no hidden costs.

team.name: Dr Youssef Amrani
team.bio: With over 20 years of practice, Dr Amrani combines technical precision with a gentle, reassuring approach. He founded the clinic to put patient comfort first.

team.name: Dr Karim Idrissi
team.bio: Dr Idrissi turns the dentist visit into an adventure for little ones. His calm, playful approach makes children look forward to every check-up.

team.name: Dr Nadia Chraibi
team.bio: Dr Chraibi specialises in clear aligners and discreet orthodontic solutions that help both teenagers and adults achieve perfectly aligned smiles.

testimonials.title: What Our Patients Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from patients who trusted us with their smile.

items.name: Salma A.
items.text: I was terrified of dentists, but the whole team was incredibly patient and gentle. My whitening session was quick and painless. I finally love my smile!

items.name: Youssef B.
items.text: Implant surgery sounded scary, but Dr Tazi explained every step and I felt zero pain. The result looks completely natural. Highly recommended.

items.name: Aïcha M.
items.text: My daughter actually asks when we're going back to the dentist! The pediatric team is wonderful with children. Booking on WhatsApp was super easy too.

items.name: Khalid D.
items.text: Fast emergency appointment for a broken tooth, very professional follow-up and fair pricing. The modern equipment makes all the difference.
